idea-plugin.name: RefactorFlow: Code-Aware Refactoring Planner
idea-plugin.description:
RefactorFlow is a Goal-Oriented, Dependency-Aware, and Explainable Refactoring Workflow Planner for Java Systems.

Features:
  • Static Code Smell Detection (PMD integration: God Class, Long Method, Feature Envy, Data Clumps)
  • Object-Oriented Quality Metrics (CK Tool: CBO, WMC, LCOM)
  • AST & Local Dependency Analysis (JavaParser Call Graph, Fan-In / Fan-Out)
  • Goal-Oriented Workflow Planning (Maintainability vs Complexity vs Balanced)
  • Automated Side-by-Side Diff Previews using native IntelliJ Diff Viewer
  • Traceable, Code-Aware Explanations
